findings.issue: Cross-component silent drop of canvasPosition on a side-panel step edit. onSubmit rebuilds the step from scratch per stepType and re-attaches ONLY id + next from props.initial (lines 925-926, 995-996, 1010-1011). It never re-attaches canvasPosition (the file has 0 references to canvasPosition). When a step node is edited via the canvas side panel, FunnelCanvasSidePanel.onStepSubmit -> FunnelCanvas.onPanelStepSubmit replaces the array element with this rebuilt step (FunnelCanvas.client.vue:286 `s.id===sel.step?.id ? step : s`, full replace, no merge), so the page persists a step with canvasPosition=undefined. The user's manually-placed node position is lost on every side-panel field edit (degrades to dagre auto-layout on the next read). This is the exact silent-drop seam the backend round-trip was hardened against (the bug that was caught & fixed for the trigger sanitizer in Task 7), but on the step-edit path it is still live. No test covers it: funnel-editor.spec.ts asserts canvasPosition survives drag-stop, but no test asserts it survives a FunnelStepForm submit.
findings.fix: Carry canvasPosition through the rebuilt step alongside id/next, e.g. add `canvasPosition: props.initial?.canvasPosition ?? undefined` to each `step = {...}` literal in onSubmit (MESSAGE/DELAY/ADD_TAG/REMOVE_TAG/EMIT_EVENT/SET_CUSTOM_FIELD/SUBSCRIBE_TO_FUNNEL/SET_KEYBOARD/CLEAR_KEYBOARD), OR have FunnelCanvas.onPanelStepSubmit merge the position from the prior array element (`{ ...step, canvasPosition: s.canvasPosition }`). Add a side-panel-edit regression test asserting canvasPosition (and id/next) survive a submit.

findings.issue: Two concurrently-editable surfaces for triggers, partially contradicting Decision 2 ('canvas is the single editing surface'). The page mounts BOTH the canvas (with its FunnelTriggerSettings side panel) AND a fully-editable FunnelTriggersPanel (v-model:triggers, add/edit/delete event triggers + on_start value). Decision 2 only made FunnelStepsList read-only; FunnelTriggersPanel was left editable and is still wired two-way. Both surfaces mutate the same `triggers` ref so the MODEL does not structurally desync, but there are now two competing trigger-editing UIs with two different save timings (canvas emits call persist() directly/synchronously; FunnelTriggersPanel edits route through the 600ms deep-watch debounce). This is the 'two editable surfaces drift / confusing dual UI' situation Decision 2 set out to avoid. (Not a data-loss bug: FunnelTriggersPanel.replaceAt spreads `...props.triggers[index]`, so it preserves canvasPosition/entryStepId on edits.)
findings.fix: Decide intent explicitly. Either (a) keep FunnelTriggersPanel as the trigger editor and document that triggers are panel-edited while only the GRAPH/step structure is canvas-only (update Decision 2 wording + tech-spec so the audit trail matches reality), or (b) make FunnelTriggersPanel read-only like FunnelStepsList and let the canvas side panel own trigger editing. Current state leaves the spec ('single editing surface') and the implementation in disagreement.

findings.issue: Dead/parallel production exports. buildPatchPayload, modelToGraph, disconnectEdge and applyEdgeValue are exported and unit-tested but are NOT used by any production component: the page builds its own PATCH body inline (persist() + sanitizeTrigger) and the canvas uses connectEdge/deleteStepNode/buildNodes/buildEdges/layoutNodes/detectBrokenEdges directly. In particular buildPatchPayload correctly serializes notes + canvasPosition, but the real save path bypasses it — so the unit test for buildPatchPayload validates a payload shape the app never actually emits. Low risk (no harm, no second resource), but it is an unused public surface and a test that does not reflect the live save path.
findings.fix: Either route the page's persist() PATCH body through buildPatchPayload (single source of truth for the payload shape, and the test then guards the real path) or drop the unused exports (buildPatchPayload/modelToGraph/disconnectEdge/applyEdgeValue) and their now-orphaned unit tests.

findings.issue: Note nodes have no text editor anywhere. addNote (FunnelCanvas.client.vue:257) appends a note with text:'' and the side panel explicitly renders nothing for a note ('A note node has no field editor ... nothing here'), while FunnelCanvasNode renders noteText read-only. So once a note is added there is no UI path to set/change its text — a created note is permanently blank. Not a cross-layer consistency defect and out of the explicit Task 8 scope, but it leaves a feature dead-ended.
findings.fix: Add a minimal note-text editor to the side panel for kind==='note' (emit update:notes with the edited text), or confirm with the spec owner that note authoring is deferred and track it.

summary: Holistic full-feature audit of 18-funnel-canvas final state across all 7 implementation tasks (backend domain/DTOs/service/engine + frontend mapping/canvas/authoring/page). Backend is clean: canvasPosition + notes[] are threaded consistently through all five round-trip seams (domain+accessors, FunnelStep.copyOf, DTO records, forward mappers toSteps/applyTriggers/applyNotes, reverse mappers toStepDto/toTriggerDtos/toNoteDtos), Trigger.canvasPosition is correctly excluded from equals/hashCode, on_start entryStepId validation is funnel-scoped via requireOnStartEntryStep, and engine semantics are coherent (advanceToNext graphMode-gated null-next=end with legacy index-drain preserved; fire()/testRun enter via onStartEntryStepId/insertExecutionAt; onStartEntryStepId is the single canonical helper delegated to by FunnelTriggerServiceImpl). Shared-resource contract is satisfied: exactly ONE useVueFlow() instance (FunnelCanvas.client.vue, consumed by authoring/page via emits, never a second instance) and dagre is transient (new dagre.graphlib.Graph() per layoutNodes run, no module singleton). Edge semantics are consistent across mapping layer / FunnelCanvasNode handles / model fields (next/btn:<i>/timeout/entry; 'no edge'=null never ''; cross-funnel SUBSCRIBE as exit badge not edge). naming is canvasPosition (not position) everywhere; note text is rendered via {{ }} not v-html. Two MAJOR findings: (1) FunnelStepForm.onSubmit silently drops canvasPosition on a side-panel step edit (rebuilds the step keeping only id+next) — node position is lost on every field edit; (2) triggers remain editable in two surfaces (canvas side panel + still-editable FunnelTriggersPanel), partially contradicting Decision 2's 'single editing surface'. Two MINORs: unused parallel mapping exports (buildPatchPayload etc.) that bypass the real save path, and notes having no text editor. Verdict: issues_found — not merge-blocking crashes, but finding #1 is a real persistence regression that should be fixed before sign-off.
